ash: heads-up — small deploy in quiet window at 2025-08-15T22:00Z to switch routing header normalization (trim/uppercase). need pin checks across api/runtime/router/console. proposed: api:v1.5.1, runtime:kernel-b15, router:normalize-header, console:ui-4.2.1. Anyone object?

deploy-bot: scheduled wave wb-10077 for 2025-08-15T22:00:00Z (5m). :robot_face:

nina: runtime: kernel-b15 ok. note that uppercase normalization can affect cache keys if clients vary header casing. recommend setting KV key-normalize=true for the window.

sam: router: normalize-header branch will lowercase & trim header. adding fallback that accepts legacy header name X-OldRoute. quick smoke passed in staging.

ash: console: ui-4.2.1 will map missing normalized header to bucket "unknown" to avoid dropping metrics. also will mute the new-alert rule for 10m.

ash: rollback triggers: any sustained route-5xx >0.3% for 3m or p95 up 30% for 5m. owners: ash (coord), nina (runtime), sam (router), deploy-bot to run revert.

sam: pushed router change to staging, curl tests:
```
curl -H "X-Route:  VALUE " https://router.staging/route | jq .route
```
returns ok.

nina: KV normalize enabled for staging. will toggle to true in prod during window.

deploy-bot: wave wb-10077 executing: api:v1.5.1@sha=zz11yy, runtime:kernel-b15@sha=qq22ww, router:normalize-header@sha=ee33rr, console:ui-4.2.1@sha=tt44uu. Canary pass.

ash: all green. monitoring quiet. will close thread after post-deploy note. :white_check_mark:
